summary: Isolate compatibility maintenance permissions from release publication

compatibility.detail: Baseline freshness distinguishes stale pins from unavailable release metadata; archive downloads fail closed after a network timeout. No runtime compatibility contract changes.

manual.detail: Upstream maintainers own review and merge of baseline maintenance PRs. Repository Actions settings must allow workflows to create pull requests. Separate postpublication jobs carry PR and workflow-dispatch write permissions; publication has only contents write access, with read-only Actions artifact access for daily releases. See docs/ci.md.

recovery.detail: A failed advance job leaves the published release unchanged; rerun advance for the latest stable release.
